title: Re-importing the old number of a case-only rename updates that part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete', See Financial Data and the Data Import setting.
  • Part {Number-A} (for example zzautotest-pl-impcase-01) is stocked at {Location-A} with Min 1 and Max 5, and 3 in its bin {Bin-A} (for example General Storage). It was created as {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IMPCASE-01) and then renamed, changing only its upper and lower case.
  • The description you will put in the file is {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Import Case CSV).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory.
  2. Download the template the screen offers.
  3. In the file, fill one row: Part Number {Part-A}, Description {Description-B}, Min 3, Max 9, Quantity 3 and Bin Location {Bin-A}, and the other columns the template requires (for example Category Uncategorized).
  4. Upload the file.
  5. Run the import.
  6. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Number-A} in the search on the Active tab.
  7. Click the Inactive tab.
  8. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Number-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the import finishes and does not refuse the row.
  • Step 6: still exactly one row, reading {Number-A}, now with Min 3 and Max 9 (it had 1 and 5). No second part was added.
  • Step 7: no row for it on the Inactive tab.
  • Step 8: one entry, with the number {Number-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-N9a, S7-N7, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour (13 Oct copy). Tech plan §7 edge cases. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 3). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-N9a: “When an import row's number matches a Part Library entry that is already stocked as a part at this location, the import updates that part. It never adds a second part on the same entry. A match ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces, so re-importing an old number that differs from the new one only in those ways updates the renamed part.”
  • S7-N7: “S7-N3 to S7-N6 do not apply to the parts CSV import. An import row whose number matches a part already stocked at this location updates that part (S13-N9a). It is never refused for a duplicate number.”
  • Tech plan, 7 Oct 2026, §7 Edge cases to watch: “case-only rename of a part's own entry (allowed)”
